cover.caption: Askeladden ror over vannet med de sju sølvendene til trollet.
cover.alt: Askeladden sitter i et stort trau av tre midt på vannet med sju blanke sølvender rundt seg. Langt bak ham lener trollet seg ut av fjellet og rister på neven.

Far behind him the Troll leans out of the dark crack in the Grey Mountain and shakes his fist. The water glitters in golden evening light.

Image 2 is the Troll's sheet; match his round belly, lumpy mossy grey-green skin, long knobbly nose, two stubby teeth, floppy ears, dry-grass beard, spruce sapling on his head, ragged brown tunic and rope belt. characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Den yngste broren, snill og oppfinnsom, som aldri gir opp og bruker hodet i stedet for kreftene.
characters.look: A lanky, cheerful Norwegian farm boy of about fourteen with messy straw-blond hair, big blue-grey eyes, a small snub nose, freckles and a smudge of ash on one cheek. He wears a faded red knitted cap, a patched undyed linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a short brown wool waistcoat, grey-brown knee breeches, grey wool socks and worn brown leather shoes.

characters.name: Den eldste broren
characters.description: Den eldste broren, stor i kjeften og lat, som heller sover i høyet enn å stelle hestene.
characters.look: A tall, broad-shouldered young man of about twenty with a square jaw, a smug grin, short dark-brown hair and a thin moustache. He wears a dark-green wool jacket over a white shirt, brown breeches and tall black boots.

characters.name: Den mellomste broren
characters.description: Den mellomste broren, som skulle stelle hagen, men helst surmuler når andre får skryt.
characters.look: A plump young man of about eighteen with round red cheeks, a sulky pout and curly ginger hair. He wears a mustard-yellow wool tunic with a rope belt, patched brown trousers and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: En rettferdig konge som elsker vakre ting og holder ord når Askeladden lykkes.
characters.look: A kindly, round-bellied old king with a long, soft white beard, rosy cheeks and small round spectacles. He wears a small gold crown, a long red robe with white fur trim and gold embroidery, and soft red slippers.

characters.name: Trollet i fjellet
characters.description: Et stort troll som bor inne i fjellet, brøler mye og blir til slutt så sint at han sprekker som en ballong.
characters.look: An enormous, round-bellied troll three times as tall as a man, with grey-green lumpy skin patched with moss and lichen, a long knobbly nose, tiny black eyes under bushy brows, a wide grumpy mouth with two stubby teeth, big floppy ears, a tangled beard like dry grass and a small spruce sapling growing on top of his head. He wears a ragged brown hide tunic tied with rope and goes barefoot on huge flat feet.

characters.name: Trolldatteren
characters.description: Trollets store datter, lett å lure når Askeladden prater rolig og smart.
characters.look: A huge troll girl, about three times as tall as Askeladden, with a round moss-green face, a long bumpy nose, small squinting eyes, pink cheeks and one enormous reddish-brown braid so long that it trails on the floor behind her. She wears a patched grey wool dress with a big faded red shawl over her shoulders and goes barefoot.

places.name: the Grey Mountain
places.look: A huge, rounded grey granite mountain rising straight out of the far shore of a wide, calm lake, with birch trees, mossy boulders and a narrow pebble beach along its foot, and a tall, dark, door-shaped crack low in the rock face.

places.name: the Cave Hall
places.look: A vast cave hall inside the mountain with rough grey rock walls and a high, dark ceiling, lit red and gold by a big open fire in a ring of stones. A long, rough plank table with tree-stump stools stands near the fire, a huge dark wooden food cupboard stands against one wall, big iron hooks are hammered into the rock, and a small golden harp hangs on a hook above a tall arched wooden door. Everything is troll-sized: huge and chunky.

The picture fills the whole image, with no border, frame or lettering. Costumes and places from old rural Norway: spruce and birch forests, fjords and mountains, turf-roofed log houses, carved wood, rosemaling patterns, wool and linen clothes. Kings and princesses wear simple storybook finery. Trolls are huge, lumpy and mossy and look silly rather than scary. Clear, uncluttered composition with one focal point and room to breathe. Cosy, safe and full of wonder. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime, no glossy digital look.

Rules:
- No text of any kind: no letters, words, numbers, signatures, captions, speech bubbles or logos.
- Every named character must match their model sheet and description exactly: the same face, hair, colours, clothes and proportions.
- Gentle and safe for young children: no blood, wounds or gore, and no violence in progress. Show danger with mood, posture and distance, never with injury.
- Draw each named character only once.
- Show exactly the number of people, animals and things the description asks for, and no extra people.
- One clear moment that reads at a glance, as a single full-bleed picture with no border, frame or comic panels.
